summary: @ornikar/jest-config-react preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<variant>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and then execFileSyncs it against a bundled math_init.js file. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled blob (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a rotated string-array obfuscation routine (WV8StW/MmgoCP shift loop) and mangled identifiers. The declared purpose of the package is a Jest preset for React, which has no need for a separate JavaScript runtime or for a large obfuscated companion script. The effect is that `npm install` fetches an alternate runtime specifically to execute an opaque payload shipped in the tarball, bypassing Node-based inspection of the executed code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
